terms.latin: māchina quae harēnam in vehiculum congerit
terms.comment: Our description, a machine that heaps sand into a vehicle: Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for a loader. Morgan–Owens has the bulldozer, currus prōpulsōrius.

sources: Descriptions and prompts labelled as ours are composed for family conversation. Recorded vocabulary does not imply universal technical standardization.
